pages.text: --- Page 1 --- KA THUPRIT JONG KA HYNNEW TREP ALMANAK A. Hynniewta 1995 --- Page 3 --- Ka Thuprit Jong Ka Hynniewtrep iimanak Da U A.

Hyaniewta (Ka hok Kynti Ka Sah Bad U Nongthoh) Sien Shon Nyngkong 1995 (This book is published with the Financial assistance from Arit & culiure, Government of Meghalayu) BHECKED Btato C f ral Libr Sa.llont. --- Page 4 --- lal Parad bad Meikha (Bam kwai ha duwar u Blei) Jonathan Thangkhiew bad Melibon Warjri Kum ka dak Ka jingburo .

bad Jingsnyewnguh iephi shimet shimet Bad Ka jinkhein kor bad kyntang ia ka kyrdan Parad bad Meikha, Kat kum ki dustur U' Hyn- niewtrep. --- Page 5 --- Tang ki jingsngewnguh Arti rjat ngam lah khlem da pynpaw ia la ka jingsngewnguh nyngkong ia u Blei Trai Kyirad, uba la pynlong bad, pynlah ia, nga ban thoh ia kane ia Alnmanak ba ki longshuwa jong ngi, ki la maitphang.
bad ieh pateng halor jong , ngi mynta, bad kaba ar kaba kham kong- san ka long ia kito baroh kiha la iarap da ka bor baroh katha ki luh. ba kan long, kan bha kabs la pyushlur ia nga ban pynmih ia ka.

Kunijuh ruh nga pynpaw iu la ka jing- sngewnguh sngewturom ia ki jong i Ma Rang- bah W. Laitphlang iba la shah sngewbha ban sot ia ki katto katne na ki jingthoii jong I ia ki jingmut ki hnai kuimjuh ruh ia I Ma Bah B.C.

Jyrwa I Nonghikai'ba hajan bad u Nongthoh kot Khasi ba pawram Iba la iarap ha kiba bun ki phang bad ruh kum I Ma Rangbah W. Laitphlang kiba la pynbeit lem bad kiba la ai ia ki jingkynthoh halor jong ka.
Ka long ruh kumjuh ia I Dr B.L. Swer; Secretary ka Khasi Author Society bad ia kiba dei, ki ,Nongkitkam jong katei ka seng.
U Khliehduh ka tnat Khasi ka N.E.H.U. I Dr.

Sten bad ia kiba bun ki Nonghikai, kumjuh : ruh ia I Mr. Rymbai I riew khmat Rangbah_ ka Seng ,Khasi bad I Bah Robin KurbahIbala shah ban bud ia kadur ‘Ka Rympei', I Editor ka kot, khubor U Nong- sainhima, I Bah S.
Syiem, I Bah Moren Allya ka, seng K.
I Bah K. Chyr- mang, Editor ka Surphira, I Pa'iem Laborious Syiem ka Hima Mylliem, I Bah Raphel Warjri, --- Page 6 --- (i) I Bah M.

Syiem bad bun kiwei pat kiba ym shym, paw kyrteng , hangne kiba la iarap ha kiba bun ki 'liang ban ai mynsiem bad pynshlur ban nang pynbha haduh ba kan da i'biang bha ban pynpaw pyrthei ia ka. Khatduh bad kaba kham kongsan eh ka long ia ka tnat ka Sorkar Jylla kaba dei peit ia ka Art & Culture kaba la iarap ban lah pynmih ia ka bad kaba pynphriang lem iaka.
To, U Blei Trai ki paid un don lem ryng- kat bad kyrkhu ba kin nangroi ha kiba bun ki phang kat kum ka jingpyniaid jong u. Kata ka long ia phi baroh'kiba la pynpaw iaka mynsiem iarap.
Kumjuh ruh iaphi ki Nong pule baieit. To ka jingsuk bad jingkmen kan iong ha-la- ki rta kum ka Jait 'bynriew tip briew tip Blei.

U A 'opathoh'nlewta (B3h Bol) Maw'ai lgr g er Shil'ong - s. --- Page 7 --- Kumno Ngi Sngew Ki jingpyrkhat ki kha ha uwei pa uwei u riew wad,'uba tih ban, shem, , uba krang ban khura bad uba minot ban kheit ia ki soh na kiba u la trei shitom.
Teng teng ,ki pyn. phalang ia ki jingmut ba thymmai, kiba ngim lah ban shu pdiang khlem da khan, da bishar.
Teng teng, pat ngi shu shim ba kam lei lei, hato kata ka biang ? Kumta haba bishar ia kine ki skit kiba u Bah A.

Hynniewta balor kane ka thup rit, sha phang “Ka Hynniewtrep Almanak" ka lah ban pynsngew thamula, balei uleit pyr- khat kumne, nalor ha ngi la don lypa ka Almanak Salonsar kaba iathuh ruh ia ki bnai, ki taiew, ki sngi bad ki iew ki hat ? Hato dang donkam ban pyrkhat da kumwei pat ?
Ngi lah ban ong, Balei ngin ia pynpait khlieh ne Pynshitom jingmut shuh nalor ka ba ngi la don ?

Lada ngi shim jingkhein ia u paid byn- riew Hynniewtrep uba khein ia ki bnai, ,ngi shem ba dei tang hapoh sor kiba pyndonkam ia .ki 12 bnai ha ka shisnem. Katba shabar ka' sor, kata sha Nongkyndong, baroh ki khein bnai'na _u.

Nai bneng, namar, lyngba, u"bnai bneng ki 'khein ia ka thung ka tep, ka puh ka dain bad ka thoh dieng thoh siej., Haduh ka rukom, iym kumta, ka kam jong ki, kala ia bud salonsar da ka Almanak pyrthei. --- Page 8 --- (iv) Kat kum u Bah A.

Hynniewta, u wan rah sa uwei pat u bnai, u ba u jer kyrteng u Nai Siat hapdeng u 'Nailar bad u 'Nai Risaw bad kat kum ka jingkhein jong u, u mih 13 bnai ha ka shi snem, ha kaba u bate mar mar 28 sngi ha ka shi bnai. Haba bishar ia ki tarik kat kum kane ka Almaak, ki sngi kyrpang baroh ki kylla lut, bad kim iahdp shuh' kumba ki lorg mynshuwa.
Kane. nyngkong eh, ka ban ktah ia' ka jingsngcw jong ki paid i..
il, shi tyllup. Ban kumne kumnehi te,kanshem jingeh ba ki lah han pdiang.

llynrci ngim dei pat ban sngew phylla, ba kiwei kiwei ki jaitbyn- riew ka Ri india ki don la ka rukom ba kyrpang, kaba ka snem thymmai jong ki kam iahap had kaAlmanak Salonsar. Ka ban pynpyrkhat ia ngi, ka long ki jing.
kylli kiba u ia br:h ha kane ka thup rit, ba ngin bishar bad pynshcngnia. Namarkata yni lah ban ong da kumwei patt, tang han ong, ngi dei ban ailad ia kane ka jingpashat jingmut u Bah A.
Hynniewta naha ka, ka long kaba nyngkong eh ba ka thoh ka iar. Katne ngi don ki prol jahieng, bad ki khraw pynaiat, nga ngcit ka biang hi ba ngin thir ngin tai i?
k diei ka lait, b d ngi lah ruh ban nang ia bynrap shuh shuh ia ki jingmut, ladien ba u Bah A. Hynniewta u la prat ja kane ka phang.
U ruh u don kam eh ia kata.

kum ka jingai mynsiem ia kaei kaba u lia leh bad trei shitom. Nga khmih lynti ba ki nongpule bad ki riew- pyrman kin ia thew ia woh hi ia kane ka jing- --- Page 9 --- (v) pyrshang kaba ratbah kaba lehse ym don ba poi pyrkhat ban tare sha kane ka phang, namar ka eh than ban ia ktaid ia ka.

Namarkata nga ai hangne ia ka kitbok ka kitrwiang ia une u Samla ba un nang im jing. mut ban nang pynkha sa ia kiwei de ki kamra kiba kham thymmai bad kham pylla kiba kum kine, ban pynpyrkhat ia ki proh jabieng ka ri, ba ngin kham pynpait pnat ia ki thied jabieng, haba ngi ioh ban mad teng teng ia kiba kum kine ki jingpashat jihgmut, kiba kham phylla.
Khtblei -/ps Dated : Mawlai, (B. Jyrwa) jewryng hep Head Department of Khasi Shillong Shillong College, Shillong 31st, Oct.

1992 --- Page 10 --- “SHI KYNTIEN AR KYNTIEN' Nga, sngewburom ia u Rangbah A. niewta uba la trei shitom bad sei madan ia ka jingstad u Barim kat kumba u lap u shem bad u kot kum ka jingshemphang jong u.

Nga kyrmen rukom jingpyrshang kiba kum kine. Haba nga thoh bad shon ha ka kot khubor Pansara na ka bynta “"Katto katne, shaphang ki katto katne" U Khasi bad ka rukom khein por, nga la pyrshang shitom ban buh jingkynmaw lyngba ka jingthoh ia kaei kaba ki tymmen Kha- si kila batai ia nga bad katba nga lah synei ban kem ia ka jingmut jong ki.

Haba ong ki tym- men Khasi, ka khamthew eh ia kito ki briew kiba la kha bad tip briew ha ka por u JUMAI bah 1897. Baroh ka jingpyrshang ban pruid dak ka long kaba shu leh kyrkieh namar ka long ka jait ?kam kaba hap ban kthong ne mareh thong bad ka por.

Don kitymmen kiba la ioh lad ban ia, shongkai tang shisien hi tnok : tangar- sien ruh ka por kam ap. Don ruh bun ki rukom kren expression) jong'ka por hyndai kiba shi- tom ban pei lyngba ne shem phang yrda la ia pher ka juk.

Ha sngap uba rim u ong "Ko ram- ew to bam maphi"' lane “"ko ryngkew ko basa to da to ker maphi." Ban thoh bniah, ka jaka kam ngiam. hynrei ka biang kat ban shu ong, ba U Khasi katba u leh, u da don hi la ka rukom ne ka system bad u da seng ha ki kynja nongrim (Principles) kiba skhem.
U jer ia ki iew ki hat, bad la ki kyrteng biang-pa-biang kat kum ka jaka bad ka por kaba
